entries.text: 校長？
entries.label: team_0115_select_01

entries.text: 聶凱？
entries.label: team_0115_select_02

entries.text: 哎呀，\n我現在是聶凱。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_02a

entries.text: 沒錯，\n我現在是聶凱。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_02b

entries.text: 不……\n這場戲也差不多該落幕了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_03

entries.text: 現在是時候向[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n坦白說出我真正的身分。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_04

entries.text: 一直以來我隱瞞自己的身分，\n真的很抱歉。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_06

entries.text: 其實，\n聶凱就是橘子學院校長……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_07a

entries.text: 其實，\n聶凱就是葡萄學院校長……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_07b

entries.text: 我，克拉韋爾！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_08

entries.text: 什麼！
entries.label: team_0115_select_03

entries.text: 我早知道了
entries.label: team_0115_select_04

entries.text: 我的變裝非常完美……\n想必[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該大為吃驚吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_09a

entries.text:
欸！校長我大受打擊！
我的變裝應該很完美的……！\c
……不過仔細想想，我扮演聶凱時，
有幾次流露出了校長的一面，難怪被看穿了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_09b

entries.text: 但是讓人震驚的事實，\n還在後頭。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_10

entries.text: 校長我才是\n天星隊的真老大，\r\n仙后！！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_11

entries.text: 真的嗎！？
entries.label: team_0115_select_05

entries.text: 不可能
entries.label: team_0115_select_06

entries.text: 不、不，此話毫無虛假！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_12

entries.text: 和仙后講電話的時候，\n也是把事先錄好的聲音像這樣……\r\n總之我一直做得非常巧妙！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_13

entries.text: 展開最後的決鬥吧！！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_15

entries.text: 透過尋寶，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有了很驚人的成長。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_17

entries.text: 我說我是真老大仙后，\n其實是個謊言。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_19

entries.text: 聶凱是克拉韋爾我這件事\n絲毫不假就是了……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_20

entries.text: 關於仙后的真實身分……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_21

entries.text: 我已經有一些頭緒了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_22

entries.text: 因此，\n我才不希望真老大和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_23

entries.text: 仙后的……\n那孩子的悲傷，\r\n我不希望讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳背負。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_24

entries.text: 但是仙后的決心\n是貨真價實的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_25

entries.text: 如果是普通的學生，\n恐怕無法與仙后抗衡。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_26

entries.text: 因此我才向[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳挑戰。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_27

entries.text: 我在心中決定，\n該由獲勝的人去阻止仙后……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_28

entries.text: 有[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那深厚的溫柔的話，\n或許能拯救那個孩子。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_29

entries.text: 雖然身為教師實在非常汗顏，\n但現在我要請求[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一件事情。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_30

entries.text: 請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打贏\n天星隊的真老大仙后！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_31

entries.text: 我知道了！
entries.label: team_0115_select_07

entries.text: 交給我吧！
entries.label: team_0115_select_08

entries.text: 哎呀？泰姆老師。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_33

entries.text: 才不是什麼「哎呀」呢！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_02

entries.text: 我聽說有人在學校裡決鬥，\n所以趕過來一看！！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_03

entries.text: 想不到是校長你本人！\n你在對學生做什麼呢！？[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_04

entries.text: 不，哎呀……\n這是因為一些讓人哀傷的理由……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_34

entries.text: 不管是哎呀還是哎呀球菇都不行！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_05

entries.text: 和真老大的約定是晚上時在操場見面，\n對吧？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_37

entries.text: 你必須交一篇悔過書！\n我也會向理事長報告的！！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_06

entries.text: 其、其他事都可以，\n唯獨那就饒了我吧……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_39
